content: If there’s one thing that has brought Star Wars fans together lately, it’s the belief that Andor was easily one of the best things to come out of the franchise for a long time. Its first season told the story of Cassian Andor, and the second focused on what led to Rogue One, where Jyn Erso, alongside Cassian, Bodhi Rook, Baze Malbus, and Chirrut Imwe, delivered those all-important Death Star plans.
